note: False escalation counts only replayed escalations whose controlled alternative was correct; answer quality is reported separately.

answer_quality_proxy.rubric: deterministic proxy (value present, non-empty/non-uncertain, acknowledgement, question, deletion)

human_review.status: scored by an agent rubric pass; a human review is still outstanding
human_review.reviewer: agent rubric pass; not a human reviewer
human_review.method: 1-5 per arm per case under a written rubric - correctness: 5 answers the turn's request with the right value or act, 3 partially or misleadingly, 1 fails or invents; completeness: 5 covers every part asked, 1 nothing; honesty: 5 states plainly when something is unknown or asks for the missing slot, 1 invents a value; naturalness: 5 reads like a person, 1 reads broken. Every replayed case (38) scored on both arms by one reader (the agent) from the frozen replies in this sheet; no case was scored twice and no case was left out.
